_note: Abominations. Speeds in m/s, perception in metres (hearing radius is multiplied by the target's class noise). dnaDrop is banked only on extraction. harvest: organ cut from the corpse (Larva). introducedIn: first milestone that spawns it. Briefs: docs/gdd/04-abominations.md and docs/gdd/larva-milestone.md.

mind.wants: Feed as a pack without losing members.
mind.shows: The pack chirps to each other, and the ring tightens or loosens with the shrieks. A coiling one swells its throat. The rest watch you, not the one attacking.
mind.plans: They herd you toward the pack, never chase one by one. Two hold you while the others circle behind and cut off the way you came.
mind.learns: If you back into a corner twice, they stop entering it and wait outside until you leave. If you kill the lunger every time, they feint with two and lunge with a third.

mind.wants: Keep its distance and make you move into the pack.
mind.shows: It hums lower when it has you, and its choir rises as it charges. It turns to keep its pustules away from you.
mind.plans: It sings to call Needlemaws toward where it is aiming, and drifts so that a wall is between you and it.
mind.learns: Once you pop a pustule, it keeps that side turned away. If you rush it, it backs over open ground where you can't hide.

mind.shows: Its lens catches the light just before it moves. It tilts its head while it decides. You hear it stop when you turn.
mind.plans: It circles to your blind side and uses foliage and the curtains between you. It waits for you to reload or open a container.
mind.learns: If you keep checking behind you, it stops approaching and waits for a noise to cover it. Once revealed, it changes the route it uses.

mind.wants: Find the intruder and tell everything else.
mind.shows: The swarm turns as one to face a noise, then drifts toward it, and their eyes flick open when they see you.
mind.plans: Scouts split up to search. When one finds you, the whole swarm spirals overhead, and that call pulls the nearby hunters in.
mind.learns: After a flare or a pulse scatters them, they search in pairs and stay higher.

mind.wants: Protect its ground and its smaller kin.
mind.shows: It plants its feet and lowers its head before a charge. It grieves over dead packmates, and that makes it angrier.
mind.plans: It stands in front of wounded creatures and blocks doors and bridges so the pack can reach your flank.
mind.learns: If you dodge its charge twice to the same side, it cuts the angle and aims that way next time.

mind.wants: Make you walk into its web.
mind.shows: It plucks its threads to listen. It freezes when a strand moves and then turns slowly toward the pull.
mind.plans: It webs the routes you used on the way in, so your way out is trapped. It strings webs across doorways near loot.
mind.learns: If you burn or cut a web, it rebuilds a different one somewhere you haven't been yet.

mind.wants: Get close by pretending to be a host.
mind.shows: Its walk is almost right but not quite: it stops at the wrong moments, it echoes the last ping it heard, and it never reloads.
mind.plans: It walks toward loot like a player would, waits by extract, and copies the movements of the last host it saw.
mind.learns: If you shoot it as a decoy, the next Mimic you meet behaves more like a real player.

lumenGrazer.label: Lumen Grazer
lumenGrazer.role: huge passive sky-grazer that panics when hurt

mind.shows: It glows calmly and slowly; it flickers and pulls in its tendrils when it feels threatened.
mind.plans: Panicked, it flees through the area, and the chaos stirs up the hunters around it.
mind.learns: If you hurt one, the herd keeps away from your position for the rest of the raid.

dunewake.label: Dunewake
dunewake.brief: Eel-bodied, legless sand swimmers the length of a person, skin like wet sandpaper the colour of the dunes. The head is a blunt shovel of fused plates that splits four ways to show a ring of glass-clear teeth. They hunt by feeling footsteps through the sand: the only tell is a line of ripples racing at you and a dry hiss. Mixes: sandfish skink, lamprey, mole.

mind.wants: Strike from under the sand without being seen.
mind.shows: The sand trembles in lines that come toward you. They stop moving when you stop, and surface to taste the air.
mind.plans: The pack surrounds you from below. One surfaces in front of you to distract you while others come from behind.
mind.learns: If you stand on rock to stay safe, they wait at the edge of it in a ring. If you shoot the ripples, they dive deeper and move more slowly.

bristleback.label: Bristleback
bristleback.brief: Our twist: the spikes are hollow quills that whistle in the wind, and the whole herd hums a low chord as it grazes. The broad back is a living water cistern: you can see it slosh under translucent plates when it runs. Young cling under the belly. When alarmed the herd stampedes together, and adults loose a volley of quills from the back. Mixes: pangolin, camel, pipe organ, sea urchin.

mind.wants: Move the herd safely and protect the young.
mind.shows: The whole herd stops humming when it senses danger. The quills rise and whistle louder as they decide to stampede.
mind.plans: The bulls form a line and drive the stampede toward the threat. The rest of the herd moves behind them.
mind.learns: If you shoot at the herd, they remember the direction you shot from and stampede that way at the first sight of you.

shroudling.label: Shroudling
shroudling.brief: Our twist: the 'hood' is not cloth. It wears the dried, shed skin of a dead host like a hermit crab wears a shell, and from far off its silhouette reads as another player. Under the skin is a stick-thin, many-jointed thing with a lamprey head on a long neck that pokes out to spit. It loots corpses and steals from open containers, then runs for the huts. Mixes: hermit crab, decorator crab, mantis, scarecrow.

mind.wants: Take loot by being mistaken for one of you.
mind.shows: Its silhouette looks like a host, but it stops to watch you a little too long. It tilts its head when you ping.
mind.plans: It goes after downed or dead hosts and full containers, and snipes at whoever comes to help.
mind.learns: If you spot its disguise once, it changes to a different stolen skin and keeps more distance.

cablecrawler.label: Cablecrawler
cablecrawler.brief: A flat, wide spider-thing with eight hooked legs and a body like a split seed-pod, clinging to the pit walls and the undersides of walkways. Its mandibles are shears: it cuts cables and walkway lashings to drop hosts into the dark. Pale, damp, the colour of old rope. Mixes: huntsman spider, wire cutter, barnacle.

mind.wants: Drop its prey into the pit.
mind.shows: It taps the cables to feel your weight. You can hear it chewing before a cable snaps.
mind.plans: It cuts the walkway you need, not just the one you are on, so your way back is broken.
mind.learns: If you fight it on a walkway, it lures you onto damaged cables. If you guard a cable, it attacks the next one.

veilwing.label: Veilwing
veilwing.brief: A wide, ragged membrane like a torn sail stretched over a small bony core, trailing a skirt of long tentacles. It glides the pit's updrafts in silence, then folds and drops. It grabs a host, climbs and lets go over the drop. Mixes: manta ray, siphonophore, bat, a jellyfish in a draught.

mind.wants: Take you up and let you fall.
mind.shows: It goes silent above you, its skirt of tentacles spreads, then it folds and drops.
mind.plans: It waits for you to stand at an edge, or in the open, or for a teammate to be busy.
mind.learns: If you stay under cover, it circles over the next open stretch on your path and waits there.

hollowed.label: The Hollowed
hollowed.role: infested hosts that still fight with their gear
hollowed.brief: Hosts who went too deep. Their bodies are still upright and still carry their guns, but something pale and rooted lives inside and works them like a glove. The head lolls; the light in the chest is the wrong colour; they fire in short bursts and do not take cover. Kill one and its gear is yours. Mixes: cordyceps, a marionette, a diving suit full of roots.

mind.wants: Use the dead host's body and gear like a player would.
mind.shows: Its head jerks toward sounds, and it whispers the dead host's last pings. It reloads too slowly and sometimes forgets its gun.
mind.plans: It takes cover, peeks, flanks and uses the dead host's grenades. It guards the place where its host died.
mind.learns: It mimics the last tactic used on it: if you flanked it, it flanks next.

fenstalker.label: Fenstalker
fenstalker.brief: A lean, six-legged hunter the size of a big cat, striped pale and dark like reeds over water, with a long split tail it uses as a rudder. It lies under the surface with only its stalked eyes up, then explodes out of the water. Wet, glossy, natural colours; the stripes faintly shimmer. Mixes: tiger, water strider, crocodile, mantis.

mind.wants: Ambush from the water and drag you under.
mind.shows: Only the eyes break the surface. Ripples point at you. The tail goes still just before it lunges.
mind.plans: It waits at the crossings you have to wade through, and drives you toward deeper water.
mind.learns: If you stay on the walkways, it waits under them and strikes at your legs through the boards.

mirebrood.label: Mirebrood
mirebrood.role: spider swarm that clusters on nests
mirebrood.brief: Hand-sized, round-bodied swamp spiders with lantern-like glowing backs, clustered round nests and old fires. Alone they are nothing; together they pour out of the roots like spilled beads. Their bite slows. Mixes: wolf spider carrying young, firefly, frogspawn.

mind.wants: Overwhelm by numbers and protect the nest.
mind.shows: Their lanterns pulse faster when the swarm is roused. They go dark all together before pouring out.
mind.plans: Some of the swarm guards the nest while the rest cut off your retreat.
mind.learns: If you use fire on them, they go dark and come at you from above.

mistwader.label: Mistwader
mistwader.brief: Four storeys tall, a long swan-like neck, a small eyeless head that combs the water, and stilt legs that vanish into the mist. Its skin is mossy and dripping. It hums. It is harmless unless you hurt it or get underfoot, and then it stamps. Hunting one is slow, loud and rich. Mixes: sauropod, heron, a walking willow.

mind.shows: It combs the water calmly. Its neck rises and it falls silent when you come too close.
mind.plans: Hurt, it stamps and pulls its head back. The fen's hunters gather round its feet.
mind.learns: After it has been shot at once, it moves away from you whenever it hears you, which drags the mist around it.
